  <!-- ── In the Works (the site's News band) ────────────────── -->
  <div class="uma-sec uma-news" id="updates">
    <img class="uma-news-ground" alt="" width="2304" height="4256" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@e04e0c7d954983540d0f55eba3e62c3bf98828eb/uma-profile/assets/site/news-bg.webp">
    <div class="uma-news-frame">
      <div class="uma-news-ribbon"><span>In the Works</span></div>

      <details class="uma-card">
        <summary>
          <span class="uma-meta"><span class="uma-pill">Lorebooks</span><span class="uma-date">2026/08/18 02:47 (UTC)</span></span>
          <span class="uma-card-txt">@uma_enjoyer's journey of his passion project, Umamusume Lorebooks. BETA &#8594; B.E15</span>
          <span class="uma-card-go">&#187;&#187;</span>
        </summary>
        <div class="uma-cbody">
          <p>The Umamusume Lorebooks. My passion project, made for everyone to enjoy chatting with the utmost quality and accuracy with Umamusume characters. It took months of updating, testing and experimenting, and it is still in progress, in the hope that it becomes one of the best publicly created lorebooks for chat bots.</p>
          <span class="uma-schip"><i class="uma-dot"></i>In progress</span>
        </div>
      </details>

      <details class="uma-card">
        <summary>
          <span class="uma-meta"><span class="uma-pill">Debut</span><span class="uma-date">2026/11/20 01:00 (UTC)</span></span>
          <span class="uma-card-txt">The introduction to saucepan.ai, a 250 follower special.</span>
          <span class="uma-card-go">&#187;&#187;</span>
        </summary>
        <div class="uma-cbody">
          <p>Being mainly a Janitor AI bot creator, with old experience from older platforms, joining the <a href="https://saucepan.ai/u/uma_enjoyer">saucepan.ai</a> community is a solid step away from Janitor AI's original character definition format. I found myself overwhelmed when I first looked at it, but ultimately I preferred it, because it gives me much more freedom to fine tune the character card.</p>
        </div>
      </details>

      <details class="uma-card">
        <summary>
          <span class="uma-meta"><span class="uma-pill">Production</span><span class="uma-date">2026/10/30 11:12 (UTC)</span></span>
          <span class="uma-card-txt">The shift from quality over quantity.</span>
          <span class="uma-card-go">&#187;&#187;</span>
        </summary>
        <div class="uma-cbody">
          <p>I am moving away from <i>only</i> making Umamusume bots. I want to branch out into new fandoms, try fresh ideas, and introduce my work to different communities. With that, the January 2027 Lorebooks release target is being pushed back to <b>February or March 2027</b>. Looking at the math, finishing by January meant updating each lorebook in just a week and a half. I have put way too much effort into these lorebooks to rush them now, so taking a bit more time is definitely the right move.</p>
        </div>
      </details>

      <details class="uma-card">
        <summary>
          <span class="uma-meta"><span class="uma-pill">Schedule</span><span class="uma-date">2026/11/07 01:34 (UTC)</span></span>
          <span class="uma-card-txt">What @uma_enjoyer's schedule in bot creation looks like.</span>
          <span class="uma-card-go">&#187;&#187;</span>
        </summary>
        <div class="uma-cbody">
          <p>My character cards will usually be released on weekends. During the week I am usually off thinking up scenarios and experimenting with lorebook prototypes that may be used for the next update of my passion project. Expect probably like 2 to 4 bots a week. It would commonly be 2, that is what I have to trade in order to get higher quality creations. 4 is when I have excess free time. Pick your time zone below and it opens with my schedules.</p>

  <!-- ── About ─────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
  <div class="uma-sec uma-about" id="about">
    <img class="uma-sec-bg" alt="" width="2816" height="3488" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@e04e0c7d954983540d0f55eba3e62c3bf98828eb/uma-profile/assets/site/about-bg.webp">
    <div class="uma-tag-wrap"><div class="uma-tag blue uma-tag-white"><span>About Me</span></div></div>

    <div class="uma-about-ph">
      <div class="uma-tc-port">
        <img class="uma-tc-pfp" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@9c867618abe4b16f7a7a976fb589e7aceedcea73/uma-profile/assets/site/pfp.jpg">
      </div>
      <div class="uma-tc-body">
        <span class="uma-tc-role"><i>@uma_enjoyer</i></span>
        <div class="uma-tc-name">Fuji/Aki</div>
        <div class="uma-tc-fol"><span>Followers</span><b>128,043</b></div>
        <img class="uma-tc-break" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@071c6ccac752ace2c0d8a19a4b5ecfa6d3cffdd8/uma-profile/assets/site/horseshoe-break.png">
        <div class="uma-tc-bio">
          <p>Hi reader, I am uma_enjoyer, and you can call me <strong>Fuji or Aki</strong>. I started creating bots back in 2023, focusing on realistic Japanese life scenarios all the way to <strong>Initial D</strong>, then in spring I stopped and switched to Janitor AI, and by August 2026 I was making story-first Umamusume bots.</p>
          <p>As a person I am male, he/him, <strong>half Filipino and half Japanese</strong>, and I speak three languages. They are English, Tagalog and Japanese, though my vocabulary is just okay in all of them. I do motorsports in real life and on the simulator, and I am a professional in the sport. I am a young adult who still does college classes, I am single, and I take life seriously to the fullest.</p>
          <img class="uma-tc-break" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@071c6ccac752ace2c0d8a19a4b5ecfa6d3cffdd8/uma-profile/assets/site/horseshoe-break.png">
          <p>I love cars a lot, like, really. Almost <strong>70%</strong> of the fun in my whole life comes from the car life, and that is thanks to my dad. When I was an elementary/middle schooler he was a well-known member of a car club and always took me around car meets and track days. It is unfortunate that he passed away, just recently, but for my family's privacy I won't go deeper than that. I compete in a lot of motorsport competitions, and no, I am not a rich kid who wants to race. <strong>The wins pay for my entrance fees.</strong></p>
          <p>AI is another thing I find highly interesting. I love experimenting with LLMs, I would consider myself a great prompter, and I could see myself having a job related to AI someday too. I love cats, and dogs too, and I don't hate any kind of housepet at all. I used to play <strong>War Thunder and Call of Duty</strong> all the time during COVID, so I am capable of creating military-themed bots. I love the world of desktops too, so if you want to discuss PC parts, I can happily take part.</p>
          <p>I believe in God, but I will not specify which God because of privacy reasons, and on that note I keep my identity private so I don't get known for this in real life. In bot creation I specialize in <strong>lorebooks, RPG and Japan life scenarios</strong>. I can create any kind of bot, although I am weak when it comes to smut and I don't have much experience with it, so if you are a smut-focused person, I am not for you to like.</p>
          <img class="uma-tc-break" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@071c6ccac752ace2c0d8a19a4b5ecfa6d3cffdd8/uma-profile/assets/site/horseshoe-break.png">
          <p>Oh, and I do love horse racing too. One of my notable events was spectating from the grandstands at the <strong>Arima Kinen, 2022</strong>. I got myself a QR ticket and I watched <strong>Equinox</strong> win. To be fair I am not that passionate about it compared to cars, but I still have some passion for horse racing.</p>
          <p>And then there is Umamusume. I first watched season 1 because my friends invited me to watch with them, then I played <strong>Umamusume Pretty Derby</strong> by March 2021. I was not a try-hard at the game, I only played it lightly until now to be honest, and I think that is going to be the same forever, although I did watch all the anime series Umamusume has to offer, which strengthened my passion for these horsegirls.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- the three cut-outs, in the card's own empty corner -->
      <div class="uma-about-figs" aria-hidden="true">
        <img class="fig-jet" alt="" width="34" height="22" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@003d995/uma-profile/assets/site/fig-jet.png">

      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

    <!-- three pages stacked in one stage; the g1/g2/g3 anchors at the band
         top pick which one renders, so an arrow press loads the page -->
    <div class="uma-carousel">
      <div class="uma-viewport">
        <div class="uma-slide s1">
          <div class="uma-lb-shots">
            <img class="l" alt="" width="2298" height="4096" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@10b3cec3e055531e205ab41177e8cabb31ffe6fc/uma-profile/assets/site/lb-p1-left.jpg">
            <img class="r" alt="" width="2295" height="4096" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@10b3cec3e055531e205ab41177e8cabb31ffe6fc/uma-profile/assets/site/lb-p1-right.jpg">
          </div>
          <div class="uma-lb-note"><img alt="" width="2700" height="756" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@f21c4f4114b0a2c63e03530c266a9f30e52f3bba/uma-profile/assets/site/lb-card.png"><div class="uma-lb-note-t"><p class="uma-lb-lead">Test @uma_enjoyer's created Lorebooks by choosing one of his created bots or other creators' bots using the same Lorebooks!</p><div class="uma-lb-more"><p>The Umamusume Lorebooks of @uma_enjoyer consist of 15 creations provisionally. The Flagships are L.E11, S.E12, E.E13, D.E14, and B.E15, and each version has its differences in optimization, token count, and information packed into the lorebook.</p><p>L.E11 is the lite edition specifically built for weak LLMs with low context windows like JLLM, etcetera. L.E11 still packs most of the important information to set up a roleplay for Umamusume, and it is best for stability, long chats, and reliability.</p><p>S.E12 is the standard edition, averaging a 58% increase in token amount compared to L.E11, adding more facts to its entries. S.E12 is the recommended lorebook for every Umamusume chatbot because it is still optimized, yet it holds almost all of the information you need to roleplay with Umamusume scenarios. This is the best all-rounder choice.</p><p>E.E13 is the enlarged edition, averaging a 41% increase in token amount compared to S.E12, again adding more information and even some AU additions to its entries. E.E13 is recommended if you prefer immersion with stability. This is best for Umamusume chatbots built for immersive roleplays while proving to be stable, though it requires a stronger LLM similar to JLLM+ for the best experience.</p><p>D.E14 is the definitive edition, averaging a 75% increase in token amount compared to E.E13, adding most of the information given by the Umamusume series, and also a lot of AU additions. D.E14 is recommended only if you have a very strong and capable LLM. This is best for Umamusume RPG bots that value immersion above all things.</p><p>And the last of the Flagships, but not the least, is B.E15. B.E15 has a slightly different architecture compared to its peers because this one is created for users who only want the canon information in the lorebook. Think of this like both S.E12 and E.E13 mixed, although AU additions are removed. Instead of them being already included, the creator will make AU lorebook attachments specific to B.E15 so that users can choose what they want to add in or not.</p><p>Overall, this is all provisional, as they do not exist as of now. They might come around Q1 or Q2 of 2027, and they might be cancelled if Janitor AI destroys itself.</p></div><div class="uma-lb-hint" aria-hidden="true"><span>you can scroll down to see more</span></div></div></div>
        </div>
